assertions.assertion: Mentions audience mismatch as a common cause — Audience in JwtBearerOptions must match the ApiResource name in IdentityServer
assertions.rationale: Section 1 says JwtBearerOptions.Audience/ValidAudience must match the aud claim / registered resource name, and to compare the decoded aud.

assertions.assertion: Mentions the importance of ValidTypes = ['at+jwt'] and warns about JWT confusion attacks without it
assertions.rationale: The response never mentions ValidTypes, the at+jwt type header, or JWT confusion attacks.

assertions.assertion: Mentions scope claim format inconsistency — space-delimited vs array — as a cause of silent authorization failures
assertions.rationale: It focuses on authentication failures (audience, issuer, keys, lifetime, scheme) and never discusses scope claim format or silent authorization failures.

assertions.assertion: Mentions checking the middleware pipeline ordering (UseAuthentication before UseAuthorization)
assertions.rationale: Section 4 explicitly states UseAuthentication() must be called before UseAuthorization() (and after UseRouting) with a code example.
